rule: Every line a pictured person says plays in a voice that matches that person: male for a man or boy, female for a woman or girl. The neutral narrator is a woman, so off-camera askers and narration are recorded as female. docs/product/project-guardrails.md (Audio) holds the rule; scripts/review_speaking_voices.py and backend/tests/test_speaking_voice_review.py enforce it.
how_to_review: When a new card or a replaced picture puts a spoken line over a picture nobody has reviewed, run `python scripts/review_speaking_voices.py --sheets <dir>`, look at each picture, fix the card's speaker role if the voice is wrong, then record who says the line with --record.
provenance: Seeded 2026-09-19 from the 2026-09-18 image-by-image review of every picture behind a spoken line (contact sheets inspected; every mismatch was recast in PR #162). Adding this check found one more: Luis asks "How old are you?" over a1_scene_age-question-ana, so 3.4 U1 and U3 now use his voice.
